# Mezric

> Growth intelligence with ecommerce context for advertising and store-performance teams.

Mezric is a read-only growth intelligence workspace for ecommerce operators, growth teams, agencies, and founders. It connects advertising performance, store context, data health, and evidence-backed investigation so teams can understand what changed and decide what to review next.

## Product

- Google Ads and Meta Ads monitoring
- Shopify and ecommerce performance context
- Spend, revenue, ROAS, CPA, conversions, and delivery signals
- Evidence-backed insights with comparison windows and data coverage
- Campaign-level investigation
- Scheduled performance and insight reports

## Current status

Mezric is inviting selected participants to a free founding pilot. The product starts read-only and does not change campaigns automatically.
